blindness: unblinded matched comparison; reviewer authored regional planner, enclosure, roles and needs integration
method: Inspected all 24 actual derived PNG sheets. Each page has four fixed seed rows with matched75% control,0%,100% conditions, and offsets0,.25,1,7,14 days. Source image pixels were only enlarged x2 with nearest-neighbor scaling. No engine evaluation, seed selection or automated visual scoring.

scoreAnchors.0: No reliably visible response at this display scale
scoreAnchors.1: Subtle contour, fullness or posture difference; weak player-facing signal
scoreAnchors.2: Clear relevant fullness, exposure or posture response

headlineThreshold: clearRelevantResponse means visual score>=2; pixel difference alone is insufficient

automatedFrozenPixelCheck.condition: Treatment PNG exactly matches matched75% PNG at the intervention boundary; this is separate from visual scoring

limitations: Four fixed raw seeds of the Cub source; descriptive cohort proportions, not independent population estimates.
Same seeds recur across conditions and ages; no bootstrap or significance claim is made for visual scores.
2x enlarged64px static outputs were reviewed; movement pace, pose-cycle comfort, emitted feelings and ordinary phone interaction were not reviewed here.
A body change may be relevant to a declared response without uniquely communicating which unmet need caused it.
100%-versus75% morphology can remain absent in one-sided shortage-led profiles; this is not counted as a failure of need storage or feelings.
Recovery has no restore intervention in this cohort and is a separate regression test.
Human judgment may disagree; earlier user feedback is not superseded by this agent review.
